patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My throat is killing me, it hurts to swallow, and I've had a fever. No cough at all. My mom said my tonsils look all white and gross.
presentation.triageNote: 16-year-old female with fever, severe sore throat, painful swallowing, tonsillar exudates, and tender anterior neck nodes. She has no cough, breathing difficulty, drooling, or change in voice.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this stable sore-throat presentation is expected to require one resource for diagnostic testing.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This adolescent has a high-likelihood bacterial pharyngitis pattern without airway compromise or deep-space warning signs.
clinical.acuityReason: Fever, exudates, tender anterior nodes, and absence of cough warrant testing, but normal breathing, voice, and secretion handling make an airway emergency unlikely.
expectedResources: Rapid streptococcal testing or throat culture
keyFindings: Severe sore throat and painful swallowing
No cough, drooling, voice change, or breathing difficulty
teachingPoints: Drooling, muffled voice, trismus, neck swelling, or respiratory difficulty would suggest a deeper infection.
Testing helps target antibiotics and avoid unnecessary treatment.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Testing and symptom treatment would likely be followed by discharge with antibiotics if confirmed and appropriate precautions.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated slumped back, both hands wrapped around a mug of tea in her lap
signs: a mug of tea held in both hands
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 16-year-old girl in a hoodie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair, holding a large mug of tea in BOTH hands down in her lap. Pose: sitting slumped back against the chair with both hands wrapped around the mug resting in her lap and her feet flat on the floor. BOTH HANDS STAY IN HER LAP HOLDING THE MUG - neither hand goes near her face, neck or throat at any point. Expression: miserable, tired and feverish, mouth slightly open because swallowing hurts. Clearly visible: a flushed feverish face; tired heavy eyes; both hands holding a mug of tea in her lap. Overall: uncomfortable but stable. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
